events.verdict: Wembanyama (SAS) sets the pick on Ball (CHI) and has established himself in a legally obtained position when he begins to roll towards the basket.
Ball (CHI) moves forwards into Paul (SAS) during the jump shot attempt and initiates lower body contact that affects his ability to return to the floor.
Vucevic (CHI) establishes a screening position in Sochan's (SAS) path when he absorbs the incoming contact during the pick.
Sochan (SAS) legally contests LaVine's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
Vucevic (CHI) and Wembanyama (SAS) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Vucevic (CHI) contests Wembanyama's (SAS) jump shot and the contact to Vucevic's hand after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.

Williams (CHI) makes simultaneous contact to the ball while slightly extending his forearm into Paul's (SAS) body as he pursues the loose ball, which is marginal as Paul is able to maintain control of the rebound.
Paul (SAS) briefly loses control of the ball after landing to the floor, recovers, and legally starts his dribble after securing the rebound.
Wembanyama (SAS) brings his hands to LaVine's (CHI) body but does not extend his arms.
Paul (SAS) does not place his hand underneath the ball during his dribble.
Sochan (SAS) brushes Ball's (CHI) left arm while both players attempt to pursue the loose ball, which is marginal.
Ball (CHI) recovers the loose ball, jumps in the air, and releases the ball prior to stepping out of bounds.
Vucevic (CHI) re-establishes a screening position in Vassell's (SAS) path and absorbs the incoming contact as Vassell brushes Vucevic's body as the pick is set.
Wembanyama (SAS) moves alongside White's (CHI) path and places a stayed hand on White's body before releasing as the contact that occurs during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Ball (CHI) steps forwards and the contact with Paul (SAS) during the start of his drive is marginal.
Vucevic (CHI) moves alongside Vassell's (SAS) path with a stayed forearm on his body at the end of the drive, which he does not extend as Vassell is able to move through the contact.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: The ball is last touched by Vassell (SAS) prior to it going out of bounds.
Paul (SAS) slightly extends his forearm into LaVine's (CHI) body after the gathers the ball at the end of the drive, which is marginal as LaVine is able to move through the contact.

Wembanyama (SAS) moves from point A to point B and brushes White's (CHI) body after White releases the driving shot attempt as the contact that occurs is marginal and does not affect the driving shot attempt.
Vucevic (CHI) contests Wembanyama's (SAS) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Paul (SAS) commits a take foul on LaVine (CHI).

Replay review of the foul called on Ball (CHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Ball obtains a legal guarding position in front of Champagnie (SAS), who creates the marginal contact during his jump shot attempt by extending his leg. Since there is no imminent possession at the point of interruption, play resumes with a jump ball.
